theorem result
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (P : Measure (E × ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hGaussian : P.map Prod.fst = ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E)
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) (hlabel : MemLp (fun z : E × ℝ => z.2) 2 P) :
    let S := {w : E // ‖w‖ = 1}
    let predictor : Measure S → E → ℝ := fun μ x => ∫ w, p.eval ⟪w.1,x⟫_ℝ ∂μ
    let V : Measure S → E → ℝ := fun μ w =>
      2 * ∫ z, (predictor μ z.1-z.2)*p.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ ∂P
    let grad : Measure S → E → E := fun μ w => gradient (V μ) w
    let G : Measure S → E → E := fun μ w => grad μ w-⟪grad μ w,w⟫_ℝ • w
    let c : S × S → ℝ := fun z => Real.arccos ⟪z.1.1,z.2.1⟫_ℝ
    let Q : Measure S → Measure S → ℝ≥0∞ := fun μ ν =>
      AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.Transport.transportCost
        (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal ((c z)^2)) μ ν
    ∃ C₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 < C₁ ∧ 0 < C₂ ∧
      (∀ μ : Measure S, IsProbabilityMeasure μ →
        (∀ w : E, Integrable (fun z : E × ℝ =>
            (predictor μ z.1-z.2)*p.eval ⟪w,z.1⟫_ℝ) P ∧
          HasGradientAt (V μ) (grad μ w) w) ∧
        ∀ w : S, ⟪w.1,G μ w.1⟫_ℝ = 0 ∧ ‖G μ w.1‖ ≤ C₁) ∧
      ∀ μ ν : Measure S, IsProbabilityMeasure μ → IsProbabilityMeasure ν →
        Q μ ν ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ w u : S,
          ‖G μ w.1-G ν u.1‖ ≤
            C₂*((Q μ ν ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)).toReal+c (w,u))
approved_definition_context: The carrier is a real finite-dimensional inner-product normed space with its Borel measurable structure. The subtype norm(w)=1 inherits its topology and measurable structure. Probabilities and products are actual Mathlib measure structures; scalar integrals are actual Bochner integrals, totalized to zero if not integrable.

ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E is the centered standard identity-covariance Gaussian law on the ambient finite-dimensional real inner-product space. Measure.map Prod.fst is the actual first marginal of the joint probability. MemLp(f,2,P) means square-integrable modulo almost-everywhere equality. No product-law or independence condition follows from a marginal identity.

gradient V w is the actual Mathlib full ambient real gradient: the Riesz representative of the Frechet derivative where differentiable, with a totalized definition elsewhere. HasGradientAt V g w asserts the actual derivative v mapped to inner(g,v). The explicit subtraction g-inner(g,w) times w is projection only at unit weights.

Real.arccos is the principal real inverse cosine. AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.Transport.transportCost(cost,mu,nu) is the extended nonnegative infimum of the lower integral of cost over every actual product-space measure with those two marginals, with empty feasible infimum infinity and no chosen optimizer.

ENNReal.ofReal takes the nonnegative extended-real value. The displayed real power one-half is the extended square root. ENNReal.toReal is zero at infinity, so the explicit cost-finiteness conclusion matters. Constants precede and are independent of all following laws and unit weights.
